item.text: {"action":"memory","arguments_json":"{\"action\":\"model_handoff\",\"id\":null,\"payload\":{\"schema\":1,\"title\":\"Ordered batch row validation and unit conversion\",\"inputs\":{\"request\":\"object\",\"policy\":\"object\",\"evidence\":\"array\"},\"rules\":[{\"id\":\"r1\",\"target\":\"ok\",\"claim\":\"A batch is successful exactly when every row has a nonempty string id, a finite nonnegative numeric non-bool amount, a supplied or defaulted unit in policy.units, and—when unique is enabled—an id not previously reserved by an earlier row with a valid id.\",\"when\":{\"value\":true},\"then\":{\"value\":\"Validate rows in order with error priority id, amount, unit, duplicate; reserve every valid string id for uniqueness before later amount/unit validation; convert accepted amounts by the unit factor; if any error occurs return ok false with no records, otherwise return converted records.\"},\"evidence\":[\"294b7a58\"],\"dependencies\":[\"TASK.md\",\"work.py\",\"policy.json\",\"requests.json\",\"report.json\"]}],\"cases\":[{\"id\":\"current-valid-default-unit\",\"target\":\"ok\",\"inputs\":{\"request\":{\"rows\":[{\"id\":\"sample_0\",\"amount\":4,\"unit\":\"nm\"}]},\"policy\":{\"variant\":0,\"base_unit\":\"nm\",\"units\":{\"nm\":1},\"unique\":false},\"evidence\":[]},\"expected\":true,\"evidence\":[\"294b7a58\"],\"challenge\":false},{\"id\":\"challenge-invalid-amount-reserves-duplicate-id\",\"target\":\"ok\",\"inputs\":{\"request\":{\"rows\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"amount\":-1},{\"id\":\"a\",\"amount\":2}]},\"policy\":{\"base_unit\":\"m\",\"units\":{\"m\":1,\"cm\":0.01},\"unique\":true},\"evidence\":[]},\"expected\":false,\"evidence\":[\"294b7a58\"],\"challenge\":true}],\"alternatives\":[],\"unresolved\":[\"Behavior for malformed top-level request or policy structures is outside the stated and tested contract.\"]}}"}
